# Wee Sites

> Custom hand coded websites for a one flat price of £99, built by Kris Sokol.
> No templates, no monthly platform fees, no subscriptions. The client owns every file forever.

## The offer
- Price: £99 per site, one flat payment, agreed up front
- No monthly fees: there is no subscription, no platform rent and no hosting cost (static sites host free)
- Only ongoing cost is the domain name, which is normal for any website
- Built by hand, no page builders or templates
- Typical turnaround: two weeks from first chat to live site
- 3 revisions included after handover
- Includes: custom design, hand coded build, contact forms, blogs, booking flows, payments/subscriptions setup, analytics
- Client owns every file when the project is done, can take the site anywhere

## Who it is for
Therapists, counsellors, coaches, chefs, restaurants, yacht crew, freelancers, creatives and small businesses. Made for people who want a real website without agency prices or rented templates.

## Where it works
Kris works remotely with clients anywhere English is spoken: the UK, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Europe and beyond. All communication happens by email, video call or WhatsApp, so location is never a barrier.

## The person behind it
Kris Sokol, a web designer turned coach based in Spain, working with English speaking clients worldwide. Also runs coachkris.co.uk.
